description: Search the live Knobs.co catalog by item type, size, finish, brand or series ("5 inch pull satin nickel", "Top Knobs Lynwood", "3 inch matte black pull"). Returns up to 10 products with vendor, center-to-center size, overall length, finishes, list prices, variant ids and product URLs. Sizes and finishes in the query are matched exactly when possible, then nearest sizes.
